Additional risk factors include very young age (e.g., infants less than 6 months); application to inflamed/abraded areas or broken skin; anemia; cardiac or pulmonary disease; peripheral vascular disease; liver cirrhosis; shock; sepsis; acidosis; and genetic predisposition (e.g., NADH cytochrome-b5 reductase deficiency; glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency; hemoglobin M).
